note: Canonical KeySentry plan definitions. Single source of truth for limits and feature gates, shared by the CLI (plans.py) and the web app (lib/plans.ts). Edit here, then run scripts/sync_plans.py to regenerate key-sentry/lib/plans.json — never edit the web copy by hand. Prices are the proposed pilot-validated prices from docs/commercial/GO-TO-MARKET.md (Free $0, Maker $19/mo, Starter $49/mo, Premium $99/mo, Team $149/mo, Premium Plus $299/mo, Business $499/mo, Enterprise custom). Maker is the proposed vibe-coder tier from docs/commercial/FREE-TIER-CAPS.md — validate by pilots; if it does not convert, kill it, do not discount Starter. A null limit means unlimited within the existing abuse caps (lib/usage.ts daily counters). Resources flagged daily:true are daily caps that reset at midnight UTC; the cap-hit message always names the next tier, its price, and what it unlocks, plus the daily_cap_suffix — never a bare error, never a dead end.
